scenario: spillPoses with caller-owned deterministic RNGs: outboard cell, positions, speeds, fan and kick, both alliances and sides, mid-swing and settled. Six draws per pose, in order (x, y, speed, fan angle, kick direction, kick magnitude).

mulberry32.note: fresh generator per case, seeded with seed; 32-bit unsigned arithmetic, Math.imul = low 32 bits of the product

cycle.note: returns values[k % len] for draw k = 0,1,2,...; fresh per case
